completed_steps: Read supreme constitution and agent rules: THE_HAMMER_MASTER_PROMPT.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, core.md, frontend.md in full
Audit sensor calibration presets & pixel pitch (Vatech EzSensor 1.5/Soft HR, Carestream CS 5100/5200, Fona, Dürr Dental VistaRay 7)
Audit diagnostic canvas & filters (inversion, sharpness, contrast, 45° pseudo-relief emboss, gamma-correction)
Audit measurements on image (calibrated straight ruler, endodontic WL along curved canal, protractor/angle, periapical lesion area in mm² with Gauss formula)
Audit 3D/MPR multiplanar CT viewer (Axial, Sagittal, Coronal, panoramic CPR slice, Misch bone density D1..D5 HU without academic bloat)
Audit Doctor Autonomy (instant opening <50ms, silent background mSv dose accounting without popups)
Check for procedural synthetic dioramas vs real pixels/DICOM

Check bird language (Mandate 8y/8z), UTF-8 encoding & CSS tokens
Run targeted domain tests and fix all discovered defects

findings.description: RvgSensorVendor and KNOWN_RVG_SENSOR_CATALOG lacked Dürr Dental and Carestream vendor keys, as well as specific sensor models (carestream_rvg_5100, carestream_rvg_5200, vatech_ezsensor_1_5, duerr_vistaray_7_size1, duerr_vistaray_7_size2).
findings.resolution: Added 'carestream' and 'duerr' to RvgSensorVendor, and registered all missing sensor specifications with exact pixel pitch (18.5 µm, 19.0 µm, 35.0 µm) and USB VID/PID in KNOWN_RVG_SENSOR_CATALOG.

findings.description: SensorBrandId and SENSOR_VENDOR_PROFILES completely lacked Dürr Dental. VistaRay 7 and VistaSoft/DBSWin hot folder pathways were missing.
findings.resolution: Added 'duerr' to SensorBrandId, registered Dürr Dental vendor profile with C:\DBSWin\Data and C:\VistaSoft\Capture default hot folders, added duerr_vistaray_7_size1/size2 (19.0 µm, 26.3 lp/mm) to UNIVERSAL_SENSOR_CATALOG, and registered ds_duerr_vistaray in KNOWN_TWAIN_DATA_SOURCES.

findings.description: ViewerAreaMeasurement interface and Gauss Shoelace formula for calculating periapical lesion/cyst area in mm² were absent. resolveCalibratedPixelSpacing lacked branch resolution for Dürr Dental, Carestream, Fona, Woodpecker, and Planmeca.
findings.resolution: Implemented ViewerAreaMeasurement, calculateLesionAreaGaussMm2 (Gauss shoelace formula: A = 0.5 * |sum(x_i*y_{i+1} - x_{i+1}*y_i)| * mmPerPixel²), calculatePolygonPerimeterMm, and expanded resolveCalibratedPixelSpacing with ground-truth pixel pitches for all major dental sensor brands.

findings.description: Lacked canvas rendering function for closed periapical lesion contours with translucent fill and area badge.
findings.resolution: Implemented drawLesionContour with 20% amber translucent fill, crisp boundary stroke, vertex ticks, and centered area badge in mm².

findings.description: WebGL shader had u_pseudoRelief bump-mapping, but RvgFiltersToolbar lacked emboss toggle and preset, and useRvgGlCanvas did not pass pseudoRelief to WebGL uniform renderer.
findings.resolution: Added emboss?: boolean to RvgFilterValues and DEFAULT_RVG_FILTERS, added 'emboss' (Рельеф / 3D) preset, added emboss toggle buttons in 1-row Hick toolbar and fine-tuning dock, and wired pseudoRelief: Boolean(filters.emboss) into useRvgGlCanvas.

findings.description: Viewer lacked lesion_contour measurement tool, area badge display, and finish lesion action.
findings.resolution: Added lesion_contour to activeTool, added lesionContours and draftLesionPoints state, added handleFinishLesionContour callback, wired drawLesionContour into renderScene, and added 'Очаг (мм²)' button in toolbar.
